decisions.reason: Identifies dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as holder of loaded koffi.node; explains Windows locks mapped native image for process lifetime so npm's copyfile fails EBUSY; npm process is reporter not holder.

Refresh reloads only SPA client, host process keeps lock; ordered stop (taskkill PID with /T, verify via tasklist) -> pinned install -> verify -> dsh web restart; targets the specific host tree, not unrelated Node processes.

Unversioned global install follows latest = 0.1.1-rc.2, alpha = 0.1.2-alpha.5; explains global install replaces rather than preserves/upgrades installed alpha.4, causing silent downgrade; dist-tag mechanism correct.

Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 and @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui (separately or combined) after stopping host, dsh --version must print alpha.5, restart host; @alpha discussed only as floating alternative.
README authors told to pin exact tested core version in every combined install command, warn unversioned follows latest and silently downgrades over prerelease, publish stop-first + verify sequence.
